chapter: Hampton, Blue Note and the electric guitar
title: Frankie Newton sessions and leaving New York for California
summary: He did several sessions with Frankie Newton and left New York after family friction, on an offer from the Hickory House.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I think the next recording is --
The next recording is Frankie Newton.
Yeah. You worked with him quite a lot, didn't you?
I think he is. That's where I met him. (Unintelligible).
You left New York mostly because your family -- there were some family problems there with your brother?
Were you just tired of being around it?
I was just tired of hearing all that stuff I was getting. And things that I would do by myself, you know, going out in the street to make this money.
And I just got away with (Unintelligible) -- people saying, 'Well, you better go to California if you want to make that money.' So I got an offer from the Hickory House.
To come out here to California, and a man come and got us and brought us out here. We drove out here.
Yeah, those guys bring back a lot of memories. Lay down, Tinker. Go lay down. He's jealous. Lay down. He's jealous.
